comments.comment: agoncharuk, who we can ask to look to this issue? is it a priority?
From the stacktrace the cause is a ConcurrentModificationException, it should be relatively easy to fix, so I cannot say it requires a specific knowledge.
sergey-chugunov, could I ask you to take a look to this issue?
dpavlov, I'll take a look at this soon.
